check.Predicate: name <> 'priority' OR (value <> '' AND value NOT GLOB '*[^0-9,]*')
name = 'priority' OR (value <> '' AND value NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
name NOT IN ('delta', 'proc', 'matches') OR CAST(value AS INTEGER) >= 0
name NOT IN ('wins', 'game_point', 'max_point', 'capacity', 'courts') OR CAST(value AS INTEGER) >= 1

trigger.name: enable_resources_when_match_finished
trigger.Condition: ((SELECT count(g.lost_1_by) FROM game g JOIN match m ON m.id = g.match_id WHERE g.match_id = new.match_id) = (SELECT cast(value AS int) FROM settings WHERE name = 'wins') OR (SELECT count(g.lost_2_by) FROM game g WHERE g.match_id = new.match_id) = (SELECT cast(value AS int) FROM settings WHERE name = 'wins'))

trigger.name: calculate_rating_when_match_finished
trigger.Condition: new.finished = 1 AND old.finished != 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rating WHERE match_id = new.id) AND ((SELECT count(lost_1_by) FROM game WHERE match_id = new.id) = (SELECT cast(value AS int) FROM settings WHERE name = 'wins') OR (SELECT count(lost_2_by) FROM game WHERE match_id = new.id) = (SELECT cast(value AS int) FROM settings WHERE name = 'wins'))

check.Predicate: email LIKE '%_@_%._%' AND LENGTH(email) - LENGTH(REPLACE(email, '@', '')) = 1 AND SUBSTR(LOWER(email), 1, INSTR(email, '.') - 1) NOT GLOB '*[^@0-9a-z]*' AND SUBSTR(LOWER(email), INSTR(email, '.') + 1) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z]*'
